properties.name: THIRD OCCURRENCE 2026-09-20: the local gate set was hand-rebuilt again, ran 17 of the 40-odd gates ci.yml runs, and piped cargo test through `head -40` — which truncated the report and can SIGPIPE the run, so 40 green results proved nothing
properties.statement: This record already says "A subset of a gate set is not the gate set", and names a second occurrence on ver:a-session-can-report-and-read-back-hand-rolled-work where a split cargo run looked equivalent to --workspace and was 46 tests short. On 2026-09-20 a session did it a third time, writing a fresh gate script from memory before pushing the `chose` increment. It ran roughly 17 gates where ci.yml runs about forty, omitted test_loop_nudge, test_opencode_plugin, test_render_views, test_skill_lint, test_wall_check, launch_serves_release, smoke_mcp, test_merge_driver, test_shared_sessions, check_consumer_reach and more, called render_skills_and_tools without --check, and ran both clippy invocations without -D warnings, which is the exact flags-not-coverage defect that filed BL-159. A NEW FAILURE MODE ON TOP OF THE OLD ONE: every heavy step was written as `cargo ... 2>&1 | grep -E ... | head -N`. head closes the pipe at N matches, so the report stops at the fortieth "test result" line out of roughly two hundred test binaries, and the SIGPIPE can take the test run down with it. The log then shows forty consecutive passes and no failures, which is indistinguishable from a clean full run and is the more reassuring of the two readings. Measured: exactly 40 result lines captured, 43 lines in the whole step. THE CAUSE IS NOT THE SCRIPT. Three sessions wrote three different subsets because there is nothing to run: ci.yml is the authority, AGENTS.md carries a hand-kept list of it, skill_lint.py cross-checks the two for coverage and spelling — and no artifact in the repo EXECUTES that list. So the contract is checked and never run, and every session that wants a local pass reconstructs it from memory. The remedy that fits this project's own three-legs doctrine is ENCODE: one runner that reads the gate list rather than restating it, so a local pass and a CI pass cannot diverge by reconstruction. Raised for the owner rather than built, because it is a change to the build discipline and not to the increment in flight. NOT ESTABLISHED: whether the truncated run actually died on SIGPIPE or merely reported short. Nothing was lost either way, because the suite is being re-run uncapped before the push and CI runs the full set on the pull request.
